title: architectury-api issue #735: [Urgent] Mislabeled modrinth 1.21.1 neoforge mod

text:
[issue by luis996]
The latest verison of Architecture, published in Modrinth, is mislabeled, and automatic mod managers WILL download it for 1.21.x instead of only 1.21, which will cause unexpected world crashes.

[comment by st0x0ef (collaborator)]
Well... it is compatible with 1.21/1.21.1 as labeled.
